description: DFSMN speech activity detection with offline and causal Stream-VAD checkpoints.

request.name: threshold
request.description: Speech probability threshold; defaults to 0.4 for VAD and 0.5 for Stream-VAD.

request.name: smooth_window_ms
request.description: Trailing probability smoothing window in milliseconds, rounded to the nearest 10 ms.

request.name: min_speech_duration_ms
request.description: Speech confirmation duration, rounded to the nearest 10 ms; defaults to 200 ms for VAD and 80 ms for Stream-VAD.

request.name: max_speech_duration_sec
request.description: Maximum speech duration in seconds, rounded to the nearest 10 ms.

request.name: min_silence_duration_ms
request.description: Silence confirmation duration in milliseconds, rounded to the nearest 10 ms.

request.name: merge_silence_duration_ms
request.description: Merge shorter internal silence gaps in offline VAD; milliseconds rounded to the nearest 10 ms.

request.name: speech_pad_ms
request.description: Extend offline VAD segments on each side; milliseconds rounded to the nearest 10 ms.

request.name: speech_start_pad_ms
request.description: Stream-VAD start padding in milliseconds, rounded to the nearest 10 ms and at least the smoothing window.

request.name: audio_chunk_duration_sec
request.description: Maximum network duration per offline chunk in seconds, rounded to the nearest 10 ms; each chunk resets network history, matching upstream.
